svg.title: One master blank, three ordered drawer fronts
svg.desc: Original teaching geometry. Left: 596 by 716.4 millimeter master blank with 3.2 millimeter kerfs. Right: 600 by 720 millimeter installation envelope, 2 millimeter perimeter gaps and 3 millimeter internal reveals. Front heights are 160, 240 and 310 millimeters, top to bottom. Narrow gaps are drawn to scale; the text gives their exact size.

g.text: Keep the order. Separate kerf from reveal.
Vertical grain · Face A · All dimensions in millimeters
After aligning DF-1: DF-3 shifts 0.4 mm upward in the pattern.
Illustrative geometry and grain lines · no edge banding or inter-part cleanup modeled
